result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the cli module compiles. I could not run the new help output: the shell refused to execute the built jar, so the help text and the end-to-end run are unverified.

Changes, all in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`:
- **`Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, with the same landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch accepts either name and runs the same `updateLandscape` code path, so options and behaviour are identical. For `-help`, the usage now prints `args[0]`, the name the user typed, with the matching description.

Not done:
- **README**: it has no command descriptions (only build and Docker sections), so there was nothing to update. Tell me if you want a commands section added.
- **Tests**: the cli module has no test sources, so there was nothing to run.
- **`CLAUDE.md`** still lists only `updateLandscape` among the main commands. I left it alone since it was not in the task.

Nothing is committed.
